response: Yes, HIV/STD control efforts in Jamaica are making a difference. According to various reports and data, Jamaica has seen a significant decline in HIV prevalence and transmission rates over the years, thanks to targeted interventions and programs aimed at prevention, treatment, and care. These efforts include increased access to antiretroviral therapy, condom distribution, HIV testing and counseling, and education and awareness campaigns. As a result, Jamaica has achieved a reduction in new HIV infections and AIDS-related deaths, and the country is moving closer to achieving the UNAIDS 90-90-90 targets.
